video_title: Draymond Green Reacts To Michigan's Controversial Win, Ben Simmons to Kings & Clippers Future

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons' return to the NBA and his health status
quotes.excerpt: I'm happy to see Ben Simmons back in the NBA. Ben Simmons is a talent that doesn't grow on trees.
quotes.quote: I'm happy to see Ben Simmons back in the NBA. Ben Simmons is a talent that doesn't grow on trees and we don't get the opportunity to see in the NBA every day. Ben Simmons got off to a very promising start in his career and a lot of people tried to blame his game and not his injuries. It sucks that when guys get injuries, ultimately, people start blaming them as a player, as if you have control over the injuries that happen. I know Ben Simmons was dealing with a back issue and I know most people don't understand what that mean, but let me tell you as someone who dealt with a back issue, it's debilitating. You cannot move, you cannot touch your toes, you can barely sit, you get tingling down your feet, down your legs, that goes into your feet. It's painful and most importantly, it's mentally draining.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons' signing with the Kings and its impact on Darius Garland
quotes.excerpt: This will take some of the pressure off Darius Garland. If Ben Simmons isn't playing well, people are going to want to point to Ben Simmons.
quotes.quote: I think this is great for Darius Garland. You have a Ben Simmons who's eager to make it right, who's going to give you the game, and he's going to work his ass off. I think this is great for Darius Garland. Let's face it, Ben Simmons is Ben Simmons. This will take some of the pressure off Darius Garland. If Ben Simmons isn't playing well, people are going to want to point to Ben Simmons and say he's not playing well. And if he is playing well, people are going to point to Ben Simmons and say, look, he's back. So I think this ultimately takes a lot of pressure off Darius Garland going into a Sacramento Kings situation that is not as great as one would like. You got Domantas Sabonis coming off an injury and all the news is about how they can't trade him fast enough. They're trying to figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's contract extension and role with the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: This deal says to me that this is Amen Thompson's team. They are handing him the keys to this franchise.
quotes.quote: I think this is an incredible deal for Amen Thompson. We've seen the growth, we understand how talented this young guy is, how special he is, especially on the defensive end. Really, really talented player who's only going to continue to get better. What this deal also says to me though is that this is Amen Thompson's team. Alperen Sengun signed a similar deal, a five-year $185 million deal, no trade kicker to my knowledge, but I do know that he has a player option on that last year, whereas Amen Thompson does not have a player option. This is the going rate for young, talented stars in the making and I think overall the Houston Rockets had to do this deal. It's not something they could think about or not try to. They have to do this deal. And by the way, you want to protect your young assets, you want to show your young asset, young player that, yo, this franchise believe in you. But ultimately, I think what this deal says to me is this, this is our guy. This is who we're giving the keys to our organization to.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Ingram's outlook with the Clippers after the Kawhi Leonard trade
quotes.excerpt: If you're Brandon Ingram and you're going to this Clippers situation, you're trying to ball.
quotes.quote: If you're Brandon Ingram and you're going to this Clippers situation, you're trying to ball. You're trying because when you look at the situation that's now left behind, it's not a good one. It's fucking awful actually and this team has no near future. You're talking a future 10 years down the road. So if you're Brandon Ingram, you're looking at that and you're like, all right, I'm in Los Angeles, what can I do with this situation? You can go be an All-Star again, you can go dominate and ultimately put yourself in a position to where the Clippers can trade you somewhere that needs you and they can acquire some picks because they need picks. And so if you're Brandon Ingram, that's got to be the mindset. Let me go get back everything that I once had and this is an opportunity for me next to Darius Garland to go and do that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Cathy Engelbert's tenure as WNBA commissioner
quotes.excerpt: The W and where it was and where it is today from when she took over, leaps and bounds.
quotes.quote: Cathy Engelbert will retire in December of this year and I will say finally. Not that I have anything against Cathy Engelbert because I don't, I don't have any dealings with Cathy Engelbert, she's not our commissioner. But what I've seen for months now, players attacking her, players putting out full statements going at her, and those are things that I know in a well-run league like the NBA run by Commissioner Adam Silver that would never happen. And so when I see those things happen, it shows me that it's disjointed and that things aren't going well and they don't believe in the leader that they're following. And if you don't believe in the leader that you're following, that's tough. What I will say is the W and where it was and where it is today from when she took over, leaps and bounds ahead of where it was. And so you have to tip your hat to her and give her some credit.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Ernie Johnson's future on Inside the NBA
quotes.excerpt: This isn't our first time hearing Chuck say this is it, but this is definitely our first time hearing Ernie say it.
quotes.quote: Charles Barkley announced on the Ben Simmons podcast that this season will be his last on Inside the NBA. Me and Ernie are a package deal, so right now, unless Ernie changes his mind next year, this is my last year, 100%. And I will say to that, this isn't our first time hearing Chuck say this is it, but this is definitely our first time hearing Ernie say it. And I do not believe Ernie will be back after this year. I think he will call it a quits. He's been at Turner Sports since 1989. I was born in 1990 and you all think I'm old. That's how long Ernie's been there. I tip my cap to Ernie, having the opportunity to work with Ernie on the set with those guys. He's the best point guard I've ever played with. That's no disrespect to the great Steph Curry. Ernie Johnson on a set is as incredible as they come.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley's impact on the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: You can't take credit away from Patrick Beverley because Patrick Beverley brings a certain mentality to a group.
quotes.quote: Patrick Beverley said on the The Analysis podcast that he helped ignite the winning culture in Minnesota. He said I really put on for the city of Minnesota. I don't know if people know this, but they hadn't missed the playoff, they haven't missed the playoffs since I got there. I'm not saying it's all me, but I started something in Minnesota for sure. I just want to remind Patrick Beverley that when he got there, young Ant-Man was there. Now, what I will say is, you can't take credit away from Patrick Beverley because Patrick Beverley brings a certain mentality to a group. And for a young talented player like Ant-Man to see that mentality and say, ah, okay, and also get that first taste of the playoffs, it then set you up for the future. So I'm not going to come on here and say, oh man, Patrick Beverley is tripping. I do want to remind him that a young Ant-Man was on his way.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Phil Jackson's legacy and statue with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Phil's mark on the Lakers is real. You're talking five championships that he won with the Lakers.
quotes.quote: The Lakers announced that they will unveil a new Phil Jackson statue on April 9, 2027 outside of Crypto.com Arena. This will be the ninth statue outside of the arena and I think man, what took so long? I'm happy this is happening. Phil Jackson and his mark that he left on the Lakers organization and everybody say, oh man, it's the Lakers, like no, Phil's mark on the Lakers is real. You're talking five championships that he won with the Lakers. Each championship that Kobe Bryant has was under Phil Jackson and Phil being the great that he is. I beg the question of what took so long. Needless to say, this is well deserved. So shout out to the great Phil Jackson and his tenure with the Los Angeles Lakers.
